title: resolve_content does sync file I/O on request path
description: posting.rs:85-101. `resolve_content()` calls `std::fs::read_to_string()` (synchronous) and is invoked from async request handlers across 15+ call sites (activitypub.rs, api.rs, posting.rs, feeds.rs, etc.). This blocks the Tokio runtime thread for the duration of the disk read. The first review fixed `write_content_files` (smallhold-z3ty.72) to use `tokio::fs`, but the read path was not addressed. For short posts this is a no-op (content_path is None). For file-backed posts, this blocks on I/O. Fix: use `tokio::fs::read_to_string` and make `resolve_content` async, or use `spawn_blocking`.
close_reason: Duplicate of smallhold-xmpo.1 (same issue, filed earlier in this review)
